text:
Hi Paperkite team,

I hope you are having a great week. I recently came across the Frontend Developer opening at Paperkite and wanted to reach out directly. 

As a frontend developer who loves turning Figma designs into fast, accessible websites, your stack and projects immediately caught my eye. In my freelance work, I built 7 marketing websites for small businesses using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, and every single one of them scores 95+ on Lighthouse. I also have hands-on experience working with Astro, building a personal portfolio with it, and I've even built projects that read data from a Google Sheet. 

I would love to be considered for the role and chat about how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration!

Best,
Alex Rao
